C0463.title: Man Arrested for Scamming with Fake Transfer Records
C0463.summary: In January 2025, a man surnamed Fang in Hong'an County used software to fabricate transfer screenshots under the guise of membership top-ups, deceiving a foot therapy shop saleswoman surnamed Tang and defrauding her of 12,000 yuan in cash. The suspect Fang has been subjected to compulsory criminal measures.

references.title: Man arrested for fraud using fake transfer records!_Huanggang Public Security Bureau
